si4_title: Molecular and micro-architectural mapping of gray matter alterations in psychosis

dc1_datasets_using.detail: The study utilized a pre-trained normative model (Lifespan Brain Chart) based on ~120,000 participants. Clinical and control data were obtained from ABCD, ASRB, B-SNIP (multi-site), LA5c (UCLA CNP), MCIC, UK Biobank, PAFIP (single-site), and ALSPAC (single-site).
dc1_datasets_using.supporting_text: MRI from individuals ... were obtained from Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD), Australian Schizophrenia Research Bank (ASRB), Bipolar-Schizophrenia Network on Intermediate Phenotypes (B-SNIP), UCLA Consortium for Neuropsychiatric Phenomics (CNP) LA5c Study, Mental Illness and Neuroscience Discovery (MIND) Institute Clinical Imaging Consortium (MCIC), and UK Biobank (UKB). ... FEP ... obtained from Programa de Atención a las Fases Iniciales de Psicosis (PAFIP) ... PEs ... sourced from Avon Longitudinal Study of Parents and Children (ALSPAC) ... To benchmark regional volumes ... we used a generalized additive model ... estimated ... from 100 different studies (around 120,000 participants; see [20])

dc3_hc_n.detail: The study utilized a pre-trained model based on ~120,000 participants. For the current study's analysis and benchmarking, a total of 38,696 healthy controls were aggregated from the various mentioned cohorts.
dc3_hc_n.supporting_text: Here, we aggregate structural magnetic resonance imaging data from 38,696 healthy controls (HC) ... To benchmark regional volumes ... we used a generalized additive model ... estimated ... from 100 different studies (around 120,000 participants)

dc4_hc_age.detail: Weighted mean and pooled SD were calculated for the combined HC groups (n=38,696) using data from Supplementary Table 1.

dc5_hc_sex.detail: Female counts and percentages were aggregated from the three HC sub-groups reported in Supplementary Table 1 (19,139, 75, and 154 females, respectively).
